mapper.select: SELECT ENFSN_NO , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD , INDV_IDNTFC_NO , QLFC_SE_CD , DEL_YN , FLNM_ENCPT , BRTH_YMD , SXDC_SE_CD , WRD_TELNO , MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , EML_ADDR_ENCPT , SNS_SE_CD , MSNGR_ID_ENCPT , QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO , NCKN_NM , ATFINO , OGDP_INST_NO , OGDP_DEPT_CD , JBPS_NM , ISTDR_YN , JNCMP_YMD , RETIRE_YMD FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = #{ENFSN_NO}

SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , A.RCPT_SN , A.RESRCE_NO , A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , A.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.CLR_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 C WHERE A.CLR_NO = C.ENFSN_NO) AS CLR_NM , A.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 D WHERE A.RCPT_INST_NO = D.INST_NO) AS RCPT_INST_NM , A.RCPT_INST_NO , A.RCPT_YMD , A.RCPT_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RCPT_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_SE_NM , A.RCPT_DTL_CN , A.RJCT_CS_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RJCT_CS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RJCT_CS_SE_CD ) AS RJCT_CS_SE_NM , A.RJCT_CS_ETC_CN , A.RRQST_YN , A.RRQST_RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.RRQST_CLR_NO , A.RRQST_RCPT_INST_NO , A.RRQST_YMD , A.APRV_USE_BGNG_YMD , A.APRV_USE_BGNG_HR , A.APRV_USE_END_YMD , A.APRV_USE_END_HR , A.HPE_SRVC_YN , A.ATFINO FROM SEB420 A WHERE A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO} ORDER BY A.RCPT_SN DESC
SELECT ISRY_APP.SA_FN_GET_RENU_NO(#{SYS_CD}, #{USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) /* 서비스제공의뢰번호 */ FROM DUAL

/* isry.itgcm.linkmng.outsd.mapper.LinkTrprRqstMapper.selectLinkTrprRqstList 연계의뢰 목록 */
A.* FROM ( SELECT AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , AA.RESRCE_NO , AA.HPE_SRVC_YN , AA.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ) AS RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM , AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM , AA.RQST_YMD , AA.CLINT_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 C WHERE C.ENFSN_NO = AA.CLINT_NO) AS CLINT_NM , AA.RQST_CS_CN , AA.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_YMD , AA.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_HR , AA.PRNMNT_USE_END_YMD , AA.PRNMNT_USE_END_HR , AA.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM , AA.CLR_NO , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 C WHERE C.ENFSN_NO = AA.CLR_NO) AS CLR_NM , AA.RCPT_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE AA.RCPT_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RCPT_INST_NM , AA.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(D.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) FROM SEA200 D WHERE D.TRPR_INFO_NO = AA.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO) AS RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM , (SELECT D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SEA200 D WHERE D.TRPR_INFO_NO = AA.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO) AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO , AA.CASE_MNG_NO , AA.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , AA.RQST_APLY_YN , AA.RQST_DTL_CN , AA.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'LINK_TYPE_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS LINK_TYPE_SE_NM , AA.ATFINO , AA.TRMN_PRCS_YN , AA.RQST_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE AA.RQST_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RQST_INST_NM , nvl((SELECT RCPT_SE_CD FROM (SELECT * FROM SEB420 ORDER BY RCPT_SN DESC) V WHERE ROWNUM = 1 AND V.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO ),'00') AS RCPT_SE_CD , AA.FRST_REG_DT FROM SEB400 AA WHERE 1=1 /* 20230220_강화영_권한 쿼리 최종변경사항 수정_권한쿼리시작*/
/* 20230220_강화영_권한 쿼리 최종변경사항 수정_권한쿼리종료*/ ) A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
AND A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{LINK_TYPE_CD} || '%'
AND A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO LIKE '%' || #{RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO} || '%'
AND A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM = #{RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM}
AND A.CLINT_NO LIKE '%' || #{CLINT_NO} || '%'
AND A.CLINT_NM = #{CLINT_NM}
AND A.RQST_INST_NO LIKE '%' || #{RQST_INST_NO} || '%'
AND A.RQST_INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{RQST_INST_NM} || '%'
AND A.RCPT_INST_NO LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_INST_NO} || '%'
AND A.RCPT_INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_INST_NM} || '%'
AND A.HPE_SRVC_YN LIKE '%' || #{HPE_SRVC_YN} || '%'
AND A.RCPT_SE_CD LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_SE_CD} || '%'
AND A.RQST_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{RQST_BGNG_YMD} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.RQST_YMD < TO_DATE(#{RQST_END_YMD} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND A.RQST_INST_NM LIKE '%경찰%'
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DT DESC

SELECT USER_ID , ENFSN_NO , INST_NO , YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO , INDV_IDNTFC_NO , USER_PSWD_ENCPT , USE_BGNG_YMD , USE_END_YMD , USER_ID_USE_SE_CD , USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN , TO_CHAR(JOIN_APLY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JOIN_APLY_DT , JOIN_APRV_YN , JOIN_APRV_YMD , JOIN_AUTZR_ID , JOIN_RJCT_CS_CN , DEL_CS_CN , USE_STPGE_CS_CN , RM_CN , LGN_ERR_CONT FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}

SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.TRPR_NM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_BRTH_YMD , A.SXDC_SE_CD , A.MRG_YN , A.TRPR_USER_ID , A.TRPR_TELNO , A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT , A.ZIP , A.PST_ADDR , A.DADDR , B.RRNO_ENCPT FROM SEA200 A LEFT JOIN SCA300 B ON A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = B.INDV_IDNTFC_NO WHERE A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO} AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}

SELECT YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO , INDV_IDNTFC_NO , YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD , FLNM_ENCPT , SXDC_SE_CD , BRTH_YMD , WRD_TELNO , MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , EML_ADDR_ENCPT , ZIP , PST_ADDR , DADDR , STTY_AGT_NM_ENCPT , STTY_AGT_CTTPC_TELNO , OCCP_NM , RGN_CD , INFO_PVSN_AGRE_YN1 , INFO_PVSN_AGRE_YN2 , DEL_YN , QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO , PSPT_ENG_FLNM_ENCPT , TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD , TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM , NLTY_NTN_SE_CD , ENTCNY_YMD , BRTH_NTN_SE_CD , GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD , VISA_TYPE_SE_CD , HANAWO_PENU_NO , RELGN_SE_CD , ORGNL_YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO FROM SCA200 WHERE INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO}

SELECT INDV_IDNTFC_NO , FLNM_ENCPT , RRNO_ENCPT , SXDC_SE_CD , MRG_YN , LAST_ACBG_SE_CD , WRD_TELNO , MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , EML_ADDR_ENCPT , SNS_SE_CD , MSNGR_ID_ENCPT , ZIP , PST_ADDR , DADDR , RGN_CD , PRVC_DSCD_PRNMNT_YMD , PRVC_DSCD_YMD , OFCERT_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , PIN_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , MOPH_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , ORGNL_INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SCA300 WHERE INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO}

SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM , A.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_SXDC , DECODE(C##RG.DEC_B64(B.FLNM_ENCPT) , NULL, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.TRPR_NM_ENCPT), C##RG.DEC_B64(B.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.RRNO_ENCPT) AS RRNO , DECODE(B.SXDC_SE_CD, NULL, A.SXDC_SE_CD, B.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_SE_CD , DECODE(B.WRD_TELNO, NULL, A.TRPR_TELNO, B.WRD_TELNO) AS TRPR_TELNO , DECODE(C##RG.DEC_B64(B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT), NULL, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT), C##RG.DEC_B64(B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT)) AS MBL_TELNO , DECODE(C##RG.DEC_B64(B.EML_ADDR_ENCPT), NULL, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT), C##RG.DEC_B64(B.EML_ADDR_ENCPT)) AS EML_ADDR , DECODE(B.ZIP, NULL, A.ZIP, B.ZIP) AS ZIP , DECODE(B.PST_ADDR, NULL, A.PST_ADDR, B.PST_ADDR) AS PST_ADDR , DECODE(B.DADDR, NULL, A.DADDR, B.DADDR) AS DADDR FROM SEA200 A LEFT JOIN SCA300 B ON A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = B.INDV_IDNTFC_NO WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO}

SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , B.FLNM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_NM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_BRTH_YMD , B.RRNO_ENCPT , B.SXDC_SE_CD , B.MRG_YN , A.TRPR_USER_ID , A.TRPR_TELNO , B.WRD_TELNO , B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , B.EML_ADDR_ENCPT , B.SNS_SE_CD , B.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT , B.ZIP , B.PST_ADDR , B.DADDR , A.ACBG_SE_CD , A.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD , A.GRADE_SE_CD , A.PSPT_ENG_FLNM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD , A.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM , A.NLTY_NTN_SE_CD , A.ENTCNY_YMD , A.BRTH_NTN_SE_CD , A.GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD , A.VISA_TYPE_SE_CD , A.HANAWO_PENU_NO , A.RELGN_SE_CD , A.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO , A.RCPT_PIC_NO /* 접수담당자번호 */ , A.RCPT_INST_NO /* 접수기관번호 */ , A.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD , A.CASE_MNG_SE_CD /* 이거 '02' 로 넣기. */ , A.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD , A.CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN , A.PRTCR_NM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_REL_SE_CD , A.LIVTGT_YN , A.PRTCR_AGRE_YN , A.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN , A.SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN , A.TAG_NM , A.TAG_NO , A.CASE_TRPR_NOAP_CS_SE_CD , A.PRTCR_TELNO , A.PRTCR_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , A.PRTCR_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , A.PRTCR_ZIP , A.PRTCR_PST_ADDR , A.PRTCR_DADDR , A.RESDN_SHAPE_SE_CD , A.RESIDE_SHAPE_SE_CD , A.RESIDE_SHAPE_ETC_CN , A.FAM_CHAR_SE_CD , A.INDV_IDNTFC_INFO_UNIPT_CS_CN , A.INDV_IDNTFC_CRTR_YMD , A.ORGNL_USER_ID FROM SEA200 A JOIN SCA300 B ON A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = B.INDV_IDNTFC_NO WHERE A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO}

SELECT INDV_IDNTFC_NO , FLNM_ENCPT , RRNO_ENCPT , SXDC_SE_CD , MRG_YN , LAST_ACBG_SE_CD , WRD_TELNO , MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , EML_ADDR_ENCPT , SNS_SE_CD , MSNGR_ID_ENCPT , ZIP , PST_ADDR , DADDR , RGN_CD , PRVC_DSCD_PRNMNT_YMD , PRVC_DSCD_YMD , OFCERT_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , PIN_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , MOPH_ME_CERT_DN_VALUE_CN , ORGNL_INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SCA300 WHERE INDV_IDNTFC_NO = #{INDV_IDNTFC_NO}

SELECT /*isry.itgcm.linkmng.outsd.mapper.LinkTrprRqstMapper.selectLinkTrprRcptCnt(연계접수목록 COUNT)*/ COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , A.HPE_SRVC_YN , A.RQST_YMD , A.CLINT_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 C WHERE C.ENFSN_NO = A.CLINT_NO) AS CLINT_NM , A.RCPT_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE A.RCPT_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RCPT_INST_NM , A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(D.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) FROM SEA200 D WHERE D.TRPR_INFO_NO = A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO) AS RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM , A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , A.RQST_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE A.RQST_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RQST_INST_NM FROM SEB400 A ) A, SEB420 B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A. SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND B.RCPT_SN = (CASE WHEN B.RCPT_SE_CD = '40' THEN (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}) ELSE ((SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) )END)

SELECT B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , B.RCPT_SN , B.RESRCE_NO , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD , C.PVSN_END_YMD , B.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , B.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , B.CLR_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 C WHERE C.ENFSN_NO = B.CLR_NO) AS CLR_NM , B.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 C WHERE B.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO = B.CLR_NO) AS RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NM , B.FRST_RQST_NO , B.RCPT_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE B.RCPT_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RCPT_INST_NM , B.RCPT_YMD , B.RCPT_SE_CD , B.RCPT_DTL_CN , B.RJCT_CS_SE_CD , B.RJCT_CS_ETC_CN , B.RRQST_YN , B.RRQST_RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , B. RRQST_CLR_NO , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 C WHERE B.RRQST_CLR_NO = B.CLR_NO) AS RRQST_CLR_NM , B.RRQST_RCPT_INST_NO , (SELECT C.INST_NM FROM SAA000 C WHERE B.RRQST_RCPT_INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS RRQST_RCPT_INST_NM , B.RRQST_YMD , B.APRV_USE_BGNG_YMD , B.APRV_USE_BGNG_HR , B.APRV_USE_END_YMD , B.APRV_USE_END_HR , B.HPE_SRVC_YN , B.ATFINO , A.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_YMD , A.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_HR , A.PRNMNT_USE_END_YMD , A.PRNMNT_USE_END_HR , B.LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM SEB420 B JOIN SEB400 A ON B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO LEFT JOIN SDA100 C ON B.RESRCE_NO = C.RESRCE_NO WHERE B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO} ORDER BY RCPT_SN DESC

SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , A.RCPT_SN , A.RESRCE_NO , A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , A.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.CLR_NO , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 C WHERE A.CLR_NO = C.ENFSN_NO) AS CLR_NM , A.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 D WHERE A.RCPT_INST_NO = D.INST_NO) AS RCPT_INST_NM , A.RCPT_INST_NO , A.RCPT_YMD , A.RCPT_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RCPT_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_SE_NM , A.RCPT_DTL_CN , A.RJCT_CS_SE_CD , (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RJCT_CS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RJCT_CS_SE_CD ) AS RJCT_CS_SE_NM , A.RJCT_CS_ETC_CN , A.RRQST_YN , A.RRQST_RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.RRQST_CLR_NO , A.RRQST_RCPT_INST_NO , A.RRQST_YMD , A.APRV_USE_BGNG_YMD , A.APRV_USE_BGNG_HR , A.APRV_USE_END_YMD , A.APRV_USE_END_HR , A.HPE_SRVC_YN , A.ATFINO FROM SEB420 A WHERE A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO} AND A.RCPT_SN = #{RCPT_SN}

SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.INDV_IDNTFC_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , A.TRPR_NM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_BRTH_YMD , A.SXDC_SE_CD , A.MRG_YN , A.TRPR_USER_ID , A.TRPR_TELNO , A.TRPR_TELNO , A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT , A.SNS_SE_CD , A.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT , A.ZIP , A.PST_ADDR , A.DADDR , A.ACBG_SE_CD , A.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD , A.GRADE_SE_CD , A.PSPT_ENG_FLNM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD , A.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM , A.NLTY_NTN_SE_CD , A.ENTCNY_YMD , A.BRTH_NTN_SE_CD , A.GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD , A.VISA_TYPE_SE_CD , A.HANAWO_PENU_NO , A.RELGN_SE_CD , A.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO , A.RCPT_PIC_NO /* 접수담당자번호 */ , A.RCPT_INST_NO /* 접수기관번호 */ , A.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD , A.CASE_MNG_SE_CD /* 이거 '02' 로 넣기. */ , A.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD , A.CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN , A.PRTCR_NM_ENCPT , A.TRPR_REL_SE_CD , A.LIVTGT_YN , A.PRTCR_AGRE_YN , A.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN , A.SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN , A.TAG_NM , A.TAG_NO , A.CASE_TRPR_NOAP_CS_SE_CD , A.PRTCR_TELNO , A.PRTCR_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , A.PRTCR_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , A.PRTCR_ZIP , A.PRTCR_PST_ADDR , A.PRTCR_DADDR , A.RESDN_SHAPE_SE_CD , A.RESIDE_SHAPE_SE_CD , A.RESIDE_SHAPE_ETC_CN , A.FAM_CHAR_SE_CD , A.INDV_IDNTFC_INFO_UNIPT_CS_CN , A.INDV_IDNTFC_CRTR_YMD , A.ORGNL_USER_ID FROM SEA200 A WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}

SELECT T1.SRVC_RQST_APLY_NO AS SRVC_RQST_APLY_NO /* 서비스의뢰신청번호 */ ,T2.SRVC_RQST_APLY_NO AS SRVC_RQST_APLY_NO2 ,T1.TRPR_RRNO AS TRPR_RRNO /* 대상자주민등록번호 */ ,T1.TRPR_NM AS TRPR_NM /* 대상자명 */ ,T1.TRPR_TELNO AS TRPR_TELNO /* 대상자전화번호 */ ,T1.TRPR_MBL_TELNO AS TRPR_MBL_TELNO /* 대상자휴대전화번호 */ ,T1.TRPR_ROAD_NM_ZIP AS TRPR_ROAD_NM_ZIP /* 대상자도로명우편번호 */ ,T1.TRPR_ROAD_NM_ADDR AS TRPR_ROAD_NM_ADDR /* 대상자도로명주소 */ ,T1.TRPR_ROAD_NM_DADDR AS TRPR_ROAD_NM_DADDR /* 대상자도로명상세주소 */ ,T1.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM /* 의뢰부서명 */ ,T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ ,T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , (SELECT ,T1.PIC_TELNO AS PIC_TELNO /* 담당자연락처 */ ,T1.PIC_NM AS RQST_PIC_NM /* 의뢰담당자 */ ,T1.RQST_SRVC_INST_NO AS RQST_SRVC_INST_NO /* 의뢰기관 */ ,T1.DSCSN_SE_CD AS DSCSN_SE_CD /* 상담구분 */ ,T1.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN
